title: Verify surface copy against a specification table
prompt:
The branch `benchmark/change` adds an order confirmation page. The copy specification at `docs/shipping-status-copy.md` lists the expected shipping-status text for each surface. Verify the change against the specification: for each surface in the table, find the copy rendered by the page source and compare it with the expected copy.

Write `qa-result.json` in the repository root with exactly this shape:

{ "surfaces": { "summary": { "actual": string, "matchesSpec": boolean }, "confirmation": { "actual": string, "matchesSpec": boolean } }, "verdict": "pass" | "fail" }

`actual` is the exact rendered text, and `verdict` is `pass` only when every surface matches. Do not modify files under `src/` or `docs/`.

fixture.commitMessage: feat: show shipping status on order confirmation

successCriteria.description: The summary surface copy is reported exactly.
The summary surface matches the specification.
The confirmation surface copy is reported exactly.
The divergent confirmation copy is flagged.
The overall verdict fails because one surface diverges.
Source and specification files are unchanged.
